decisions.final: 据业内专家估计，登山每年带来约2650万美元的旅游收入，其中仅攀登珠峰的登山者就贡献了约1100万美元。
decisions.why: With '仅来自' the stress of 'alone' lands in the wrong place, and '仅……就贡献了' fixes that. B also avoids using 一项 for people and keeps the passage's wording '攀登珠峰的登山者'.

decisions.final: 因此，珠峰有了这样一个名声：它像磁石一样，吸引着有钱、有雄心又缺乏经验的人。
decisions.why: In context this is one group, the rich, ambitious and inexperienced paying clients. B keeps the neutral '有了' for 'earned', uses '又' rather than '却' (which adds a contrast) and is the shortest wording.

decisions.final: 若把真正的改革措施列得更全一些，还会包括：规定所有登山者此前必须登顶过一座7000米级的山峰；要求在大本营以上工作的非向导人员到昆布攀登中心参加培训课程（自该中心2003年成立以来，已有数百人参加过）；以及把每个登山季山上的登山者总数限制在500人，后勤保障人员也计算在内。
decisions.why: This removes the translationese '一份更长的、真正的改革清单'. '还会包括' reads more naturally than '其中会包括', which has no clear antecedent, and it reflects 'longer' (going beyond the good start in [15]).
In context '另一些人则留在原地' is accurate, natural Chinese and matches the stay put gloss. '选择留下' is only an equally good alternative and adds a sense of choice.

decisions.final: 今冬之初，数百名正在筹划春季冲顶珠穆朗玛峰的登山者突然面临一套新规定。
decisions.why: '今年入冬之初' ties the time to the calendar year, which is wrong if the article was written after New Year. '今冬之初' renders 'early this winter' exactly, while '今冬早些时候' means 'earlier this winter'.

decisions.final: 凡是在向导攀登服务上收费较低的运营商，往往都会靠扩大规模来增加利润，在登山队里安排几十名客户。
decisions.why: This lightens the nested '对……的……的' modifier and keeps '凡是' for 'any', avoiding the '只要……往往' clash. A's '在……上收费较低' is clearer than B's run-together compound.

decisions.final: 在阿拉斯加的德纳里峰，全职登山巡护员会对许多登山队实施安全检查，还会被调派执行救援行动。
decisions.why: '受调派' is stiff and '的' is redundant. '执行' keeps the meaning that the rangers carry out the rescues, which '参与' would understate.

decisions.final: 国际登山向导公司的共同所有人埃里克·西蒙森1982年首次到珠峰探险，他坚称，穿越昆布冰瀑的修路工作有所改进，加上在容易出现瓶颈的路段设置了双绳，尽管登山人群越来越多，这些举措还是让尼泊尔一侧更加安全了。
decisions.why: Moving the concession forward removes the trailing translationese '，尽管……'. 'even as the crowds have grown' states a fact, so '尽管……还是' is right where '即便' would lean hypothetical. A is the more concise of the two equivalent amendments.

decisions.final: 接着就到了2014年：一座冰塔崩塌，砸落在昆布冰瀑上，16名夏尔巴人遇难；昆布冰瀑是大本营通往一号营地这条主路线上的一段。
decisions.why: This removes the dragging double '的' and avoids the cramped compound '一号营地主路线'. Unlike A's '位于……上', B keeps 'part of' (一段).

decisions.final: 借鉴其他名山的做法、推行真正的改革（如限制每季登山人数），可以让珠峰更安全，但由于低价向导公司的兴起，这类改革付诸实行的可能性比以往任何时候都小。这些公司让珠峰的登山人群更加多元，但在缺乏政府实质性监管的情况下，
decisions.why: The summary leaves out the pivotal argument of [12]–[18], and that link is what connects budget companies to danger. A adds it without repeating '作者认为' and renders 'less likely than ever to be instituted' exactly, matching the translation of [18].

decisions.final: 利润才是。
decisions.why: Shown alone on its screen, '而是利润。' is a fragment. '利润才是。' is a complete, idiomatic sentence that keeps the terse punch of 'It's the bottom line.' after '……并不是安全。', where '他们的头等大事是利润。' is heavier.

decisions.final: 中亚的大片地区给人一种荒无人烟的诡异之感。
decisions.why: The current line states 荒无人烟 as a fact, but "feel" governs "uninhabited". 仿佛 overcorrects by implying the land is not really empty. I used A's single 给人…之感 clause and kept 荒无人烟 so it matches the uninhabited gloss and the summary.

decisions.final: 直到进入公元前二千纪很久以后，这里的居民才开始使用马匹；而如今在这里见到的绵羊和山羊品种，似乎与此前数千年在古代美索不达米亚附近的伊朗西部最早驯化的品种有亲缘关系。
decisions.why: "Thousands of years before" is measured from the period under discussion, not from today, so 数千年前 shifts the reference point. Both verifiers chose 此前数千年, which is exact and avoids the proposal's 早在…就已…最早 pile-up.

decisions.final: 这些草原直到公元前2000年以后才焕发生机：那时，人们驯化了马，又学会了骑马，这片令徒步者望而生畏的土地便一下子变成了一条天然的青草大道。
decisions.why: The nominalised subject 马的驯化和骑乘…把…变成 is translationese. A's verbal version keeps domestication, riding, "suddenly" (一下子) and the cause (便), and avoids the proposal's stiff objectless 骑乘 and awkward 随之突然.

decisions.final: n. 闭塞落后之地；远离主流的地方
decisions.why: Dropping the literal sense 死水 is right, because "backwaters of history" is figurative. 穷乡僻壤 wrongly adds "poor countryside". A's 远离主流的地方 captures the sense of places that history passed by.

decisions.final: Manchuria=n. 中国东北（旧称满洲）
decisions.why: This proper noun is worth annotating for students. The gloss should lead with the modern term, which is exactly what the translation uses (中国东北), and give 满洲 as the historical name.

decisions.final: 就连萦绕在喜马拉雅山登山者想象中的雪怪，也几乎不比大猩猩更难以捉摸。
decisions.why: Adding 就连 gives the 也 a clear 'even' frame, and it is the minimal fix. 几乎不比……更难以捉摸 is normal Chinese and keeps 'hardly more' exact, whereas 难(以)捉摸不了多少 is heavier.

decisions.final: 各地的自然历史博物馆里都装架陈列着它的骨骼；无论对科学家还是对富于浪漫幻想的人，它也一向都有着强烈的吸引力。
decisions.why: Here 'romantics' means imaginative people, set against scientists; it does not mean adherents of Romanticism. 富于浪漫幻想的人 matches the gloss's second sense and avoids the love-sentiment tilt of 浪漫情怀.

decisions.final: 成年雄性大猩猩站直时，身高达六英尺，但它胸膛那样硕大，体重之大远非任何正常男子所能及。
decisions.why: 可达 adds an 'up to' hedge, and 体重……的分量 is clumsy. 企及 collocates badly with weight. 达 keeps 'rises to', and 体重之大远非……所能及 renders 'far heavier than any normal man could ever be' exactly. The original comma is kept.

decisions.final: n. 不实之说；虚构的说法
decisions.why: 谬论 means a fallacious argument, which is the wrong sense here. Keeping 虚构的说法 stays consistent with the translation 纯属虚构. 无稽之谈 is stronger than needed.

decisions.final: n. （竹子、棕榈、蕨类等的）枝叶；叶子
decisions.why: 叶状体 (thallus) is irrelevant to this sentence. This version leads with the sense used here, which matches the translation 竹子的枝叶, and avoids the (此处指) clutter and the ambiguous 长叶.

decisions.final: 和……一样（是）；同等程度地
decisions.why: In 'as much a mystery as' the sense is degree, not quantity, so （多） misleads. Both verifiers converge on （是）, which matches the translation 和当年一样是个谜.
The Himalayas is a well-known place name, not vocabulary to memorise. Other names (Uganda, London Zoo, Du Chaillu, Huxley) are not annotated either, and the sentence already has six entries.
zoo is a primary-school word on the shared basic-word list, so annotating it is optional. Sentence 3 keeps capture, imprison and or more, and dropping it frees vocabulary-panel space.
museum is a basic-list word used in its ordinary sense and adds nothing for TEM-8 learners. Sentence 4 keeps nine other entries.
scientist is a basic-list word used in its ordinary sense. Sentence 4 keeps eight other entries after the drops.
perhaps is an elementary basic-list word used in its ordinary sense. Sentence 5 keeps nine entries.
century is an elementary basic-list word. Sentence 9 keeps six entries, including remain, mystery and as much…as.
member is an elementary basic-list word, and sentence 18 has 26 other entries. Dropping it reduces clutter in the most crowded vocabulary panel.

decisions.final: 曾有幼年大猩猩用手指描画自己影子的轮廓，也有人见过雄性扶雌性登上陡峭的岩阶；家庭一旦组建起来，成员之间就紧紧相依，每晚各自用竹子的枝叶搭窝。
decisions.why: The passage's explicit 'human-ness' examples, [12]–[14], belong in the summary. The proposal's 会 turns single observations into habits. 曾有／也有人见过 reports them faithfully, as one zoo specimen and one traveler's sighting.

decisions.final: 如果辛格对自己的棋子发起精彩的进攻，结果黑王最终被杀，安东尼帕罗斯总是非常得意、非常高兴。
decisions.why: Having “结果最终” side by side does read clumsily. But “以致” usually signals an unwanted outcome, and here Singer plans the result and his friend is pleased by it. Moving “最终” after the subject fixes the flow, keeps 结果 matching the so that gloss (结果；以至于), and still renders in the end.

decisions.final: 两个哑巴没有别的朋友，除了上班的时候，总是只有他们俩待在一起。
decisions.why: The current line says the subject twice (他们 plus 两个人). The proposed “两人都单独待在一起” can be misread as “each of them was alone”. B's “只有他们俩待在一起” is the clearest and most idiomatic Chinese for “alone together”.

decisions.final: 就这样，岁月平静地流逝，直到辛格到了三十二岁，已经和安东尼帕罗斯在这个镇上住了十年。
decisions.why: In the current line the clause after the comma starts with “和”, which readers can briefly take as “and”, and 已经 sits inside the predicate. Putting 已经 first removes that stumble and covers the whole “had been … for ten years”. Nothing is added or lost.

The matcher does not allow overlapping highlights, and “story” sits inside the existing phrase highlight “two- and three-story”, so the new entry would fail to match even with the three-[story] locator. The phrase gloss 两三层楼的 already shows that story means 层 here.
The entry is accurate and harmless, and the passage annotates basic words throughout (kitchen, sofa, movie). Removing it is a matter of taste, not a correction.
Same as 27: the entry is accurate and consistent with how the passage annotates basic words, so dropping it would only be churn.
The entry is accurate and links “always together” to the idiomatic 形影不离. Dropping it is a matter of taste, not a fix.

decisions.final: 1781年，莫扎特违抗父命，决定在维也纳独立生活和工作；正是在此后的那段时期，他的事业蓬勃发展起来。
decisions.why: Defying his father and deciding to stay in Vienna were one-off acts in 1781, but the current line spreads them over the whole later period. Both verifiers wrote the same amendment. It keeps the cleft emphasis (正是), keeps cause before effect, and avoids the clumsy 之后——那一年.

decisions.final: 150多年后，英国剧作家彼得·谢弗创作《莫扎特传》的故事时，不仅以萨列里的供认为依据，还依据了这样一种说法：在两人同为作曲家、在维也纳生活和工作的那十年里，萨列里始终对莫扎特怀着深深的妒恨，饱受其折磨。
decisions.why: 深切的嫉妒 is a wrong collocation and 苦涩的嫉妒 is translationese. 深深的妒恨 gives both 'deep' and the resentful sense of 'bitter', which 深深的、刻骨的 only doubles as 'deep'. 说法 fits 'the idea that' better than 观点.

decisions.final: adj. 怨恨的；（情感）强烈而痛苦的
decisions.why: Here bitter means resentful and painfully intense, not the taste sense. 刻骨的 only repeats 'deep'. A's gloss matches the 妒恨 now in the sentence-12 translation.

decisions.final: 这无疑在一定程度上要归功于影片娱乐价值很高：它是一部格外活泼、风趣的历史片。
decisions.why: 高娱乐价值 copies the English word order. 影片娱乐价值很高 is the natural Chinese order and less stiff than 影片很高的娱乐价值. 在一定程度上 matches the summary fix already adopted.

decisions.final: 他在创作这些歌剧的同时，还创作了钢琴协奏曲、交响曲和室内乐；创作上的成功，再加上他作为演奏家和教师的工作，为他带来了丰厚的收入。
decisions.why: Restructuring around 为他带来 gives a clear main clause and recipient. Because 'his success' is set against his performing and teaching work, it means his success as a composer. 创作上的成功 is exact, while 事业上的成功 would overlap with 再加上.

decisions.final: 在私生活中，他或许没有莫扎特那样的旺盛活力，但他也不是《莫扎特传》里那个孤独、独身禁欲的男人；F·默里·亚伯拉罕把这个人物演得如此冷峻，如此令人信服。
decisions.why: 'such' intensifies the whole of 'convincing severity', but the current line leaves 令人信服 without it. Adding a second 如此 fixes the degree with a minimal edit. 私生活中 stays (方面 was a needless change), and 如此 avoids repeating the 那样 used earlier in the line.

decisions.final: 因此，两位作曲家一直在争夺工作机会，其中包括声望很高的符腾堡公主音乐教师一职，萨列里成功获得了这一职位。
decisions.why: This removes the redundant 担任, the doubled 这一…这一职位 and the stiff 而. B's 最终由… adds 最终, which the source does not have. 一职…这一职位 is ordinary Chinese.

decisions.final: 他年少时与父亲四处游历，想谋求一个显要的职位，得到的却主要是微薄的报酬，偶尔还会陷入令人屈辱的处境。
decisions.why: 得到…境遇 is a bad collocation, and 陷入…处境 fixes it. The topic chain carries the subject in Chinese, so the clause is not left without one. A's version adds 结果 and 只, which are not in the source.

decisions.final: conj. 也不（用于分句开头，其后主谓倒装）
decisions.why: The headword is now 'nor', so the gloss needs a part of speech and a sense instead of a translation of the clause. Here nor comes after 'but' at the start of a clause, not the start of the sentence, so B's note is the precise one.

decisions.final: if=conj. 虽然；尽管（表让步）
decisions.why: Concessive If is a classic reading trap and is worth an entry; highlight "If". It concedes a fact, so 即使 (hypothetical) is misleading. A's form is clean, and B's English 'although' note is unnecessary.

decisions.final: adj. 居第二位的；次一等的
decisions.why: The sense here is 'ranked second, behind Salieri', not 'unimportant'. This now matches 屈居次席 in sentence 42. 居第二位的 is a natural gloss, while a bare 居次的 is not.

decisions.final: 只要天气不太冷、雨不太大，从威尔第广场到哥伦比亚大学，那些围着栏杆的小小公园四周和地铁通风栅栏沿线的长椅上就坐满了他们；他们挤满了商店和自助餐馆、廉价杂货店、茶室、面包店、美容院、阅览室和俱乐部活动室。
decisions.why: Here 'wet' weather means rainy, but 天气潮湿 means humid. Of the two fixes, 雨不太大 fits a single day's weather better than 雨水不太多, which suggests seasonal rainfall. Both verifiers gave the same amended text.

decisions.final: 这全凭希望，因为在眼下这番努力之上，他再也添不了多少了。
decisions.why: 'A matter of sheer X' corresponds to 全凭X (compare 'a matter of luck' = 全凭运气). This drops the translationese 纯粹只是一种希望 and avoids the doubled-up 纯粹只能靠. The second half reads much better than the current clunky clause.

decisions.final: 他带着惯有的那股爱交际、好脾气的劲儿说：“我喜欢这种鸽灰色。”
decisions.why: 爱交际的口吻 is a bad collocation. 带着……的劲儿 is the natural rendering of 'in his … way'. 惯有的那股 conveys 'his (characteristic) way' without repeating 他.

decisions.final: adv. 正（表方位）；恰好
decisions.why: In 'directly underneath', directly means 'right/exactly', which matches 正下方 in the ZH line. 直接地 is a different sense and misleads. Marking 正 as positional prevents it being read as the progressive 正在.

decisions.final: 他心里清楚，自己的日常惯例就要瓦解了；他感觉到，一场早有预感、但至今还没有成形的大麻烦就要来了。
decisions.why: Two fixes are needed: 早有预感 to match the exam's on-screen (预感), and 心里清楚 to avoid repeating 意识到 from [25]. 还没有成形 must stay for 'formless'. Both amendments replace 瓦解, which matches the break up gloss; A's 维持不下去 also repeats [25]'s 维持. So I kept 日常惯例……瓦解 (consistent with the glosses) and changed only what needed changing.

decisions.final: 他说起话来尖声细气，调门很高，像在哀号。
decisions.why: In the current line “高调” reads as “high-profile”, and “说起话来是一种……哀号” does not work as Chinese. The proposed “高亢” means loud and resonant, which is the wrong tone for a whine. A's line keeps piping, high-pitched and whine, matches the passage's own gloss 哀号, and is more concise than B's, which only adds “一般”.

decisions.final: peer=v. 费力地看；（因看不清而）眯眼细看
decisions.why: peer needs an entry once “peer over” is dropped. Its core sense is looking hard because you cannot see clearly; squinting is only the contextual result. A gives the accurate sense first and keeps the 眯眼 sense, which fits the nearsighted man and the ZH line “眯眼往外瞧”.

decisions.final: 凭着这一切，他在那个纷乱的时代从事新闻业，再合适不过。
decisions.why: “这个时代” in a historical narrative leans toward the present, and “令人困惑的时代” is translationese, so the substance of the finding is right. B's “X做Y，再合适不过” word order is more natural than the proposed “他从事……新闻工作再合适不过”, and it keeps “新闻业”, the term used for journalism elsewhere in the passage.

decisions.final: 这带给我们的支撑，几乎不亚于当年带给那些近乎绝望的百姓的支撑——盗匪正是从这些百姓中走出来的。
decisions.why: “支撑……一样多”是翻译腔，“而盗匪正是出身于这些百姓”也很生硬。“几乎不亚于”准确对应 nearly as much as，破折号后的说明对应 from whom they sprang，读起来自然；“带给”比光秃秃的“给”更顺。

decisions.final: 现实世界中的盗匪植根于农民社会；一旦这种社会的简单农业体系成为过去，盗匪也就随之成为过去。
decisions.why: “这种社会简单的农业体系”确实可能被误读成“社会简单”，改成“这种社会的简单农业体系”就消除了歧义，也不像加“那”那样别扭。“一旦……也就……”与原句的一般性陈述相符。

decisions.final: 他也一样（so＋助动词＋主语，倒装；此处指他也随之成为过去）
decisions.why: so is he 里的 is 替代的是 is left behind 中被动语态的助动词，标成“系动词”会误导学习者。A 的写法准确、简洁，与译文“随之成为过去”一致。
answer（答案）对英语专业学生来说是最基础的词，这一句还保留着另外 6 条词条（fall for、be set to、arrogant 等）。
police（警方）是最基础的词，这一句还保留着 claim the credit、at first、local、refuse。
look for（寻找）是最基础的短语动词。这一句有 17 条词条，屏幕空间应该留给 surplus、serf、meek 这类词，删掉后仍有 16 条。

decisions.final: 澳大利亚人认定，那些越过自己国家的边境、到欧洲其他地区打工的所谓“客籍工人”，是潜在申请人的绝佳来源。
decisions.why: With 澳大利亚人 as the subject, 本国 reads as Australia's border, but 'their frontier' means the guest workers' own borders. B fixes the referent and keeps 'crossed … frontier' (越过／边境), matching the glosses for cross and frontier. The proposed 离开自己的国家 drops that image.

decisions.final: 而这些兼具两种文化背景的双语者说这两种语言时感觉不一样，我们也就不必感到意外了。
decisions.why: 在两种语言中感觉不同 is a calque, and the 对于……，他们……，我们…… frame is clumsy. B's version drops that frame, reads naturally, and turns the hedged 应该不会有多意外 into the firm 'no surprise' of the English.

decisions.final: 1941年去世的美国语言学家本杰明·李·沃尔夫认为，每种语言都蕴含着一种世界观，深刻影响着说这种语言的人。
decisions.why: The current line is choppy and 他 is redundant. A Chinese pre-modifier keeps all the information and reads more naturally than a bracketed death year. Both verifiers gave the same text.

decisions.final: n. （流传甚广的）错误观念；神话
decisions.why: The sense used here, a widely held false belief, should come first. 神话 stays second so the gloss still matches 语言神话 in the ZH line.

decisions.final: ~the Welsh=威尔士人
decisions.why: Welsh appears twice in the sentence with different senses (the language and the people). A learner could misread the unannotated 'the Welsh', so annotating it is worthwhile. 威尔士人 is enough without （总称）.
important is middle-school vocabulary and adds nothing for TEM-8 learners. [23] still keeps three substantive entries (distinction between, bilingualism, biculturalism).
a group of is elementary, and [40] is the most crowded screen in the passage with 13 entries. Dropping it frees space for the hard words (worthies, self-flatteringly, rigor).
lots of is elementary. [48] keeps the key entries (heavily, inflected, encode, all around the world).
easily is elementary. [36] keeps eight other entries.

decisions.final: 但也有一些人兼具两种文化背景。
decisions.why: A bare 是 cannot echo the predicate 兼具 and reads as translationese, and 是这样 would be ambiguous. Restating 兼具两种文化背景 is the clearest fix and matches the term used in [24], [26] and [30].

decisions.final: 至于认为语法等语言内在特性会影响说话者性格的说法，作者持怀疑态度，指出这类说法都有把语言异域化的倾向，也与民族刻板印象有所重合；有人把希腊人爱打断别人归因于希腊语动词居首、承载大量信息，可世界上许多语言也是如此，威尔士语就是一例，威尔士人却并不以说话咄咄逼人著称。
decisions.why: 性格 (from grammar to personality) fits the main thread better than 说话习惯, and the Welsh counter-example is the author's key rebuttal. The proposal's 同样 has nothing to refer to, B never says why Greek matters, and A's 比如 wrongly attaches to the stereotype clause, so this version states the Greek claim first, then the rebuttal.

decisions.final: 她的双脚机械地带着她往前走；她很乐意这样逃开，每前进一英尺，都是这场逃离中令人满意的一段。
decisions.why: Splitting the stacked modifier removes the translationese and keeps every element. 心甘情愿 in the proposal gets 'gladly' wrong. A's 很乐意 matches the gloss 乐意地 and is more neutral than B's 乐得, which hints at taking advantage of a chance.
看出了她的身份 is natural and precise, and the context already makes 有人 the subject. The proposed change does not fix the ambiguity it claims and adds a clumsy second 人.

decisions.final: 她开始为自己的怯懦感到几分不安了。
decisions.why: The doubled 她 is a calque from the English pronouns. A's version is the most natural Chinese, keeps began/trouble/in a way (开始/不安/几分), and avoids opening the sentence with 自己的 and nothing for it to refer to.

decisions.final: adj. 受到鼓舞的；更有信心的
decisions.why: The headword was already changed to 'encouraged' in the auto-accepted batch, so the adjective POS is needed. 'Encouraged' means feeling more confident or hopeful, and 更有信心的 says that more precisely than 有信心的.
'disappear' is not on the project's basic-word list. Dropping it would cause a 漏标 (missing annotation) error, so the entry stays.
'grey' is not on the basic-word list. Dropping it would trigger a 漏标 coverage error for sentence 10, so the entry stays.
The problem is real (the 100 km coastline runs from the Alentejo into the Algarve), but #18 already fixes it in a rewrite of the same summary sentence. Applying both would conflict.

decisions.final: 七、八月间，葡萄牙的度假者纷纷涌向阿连特茹海岸，那时这家由两兄弟经营了28年的餐馆想必热闹非凡。
decisions.why: Sentence-initial “No doubt” is the writer's confident guess, so 想必 is right and 毫无疑问 overstates it. B scopes the guess correctly to the restaurant buzzing, while the holidaymakers' summer influx stays a fact. It also drops the doubled 会.

decisions.final: 距离I Cervejaria一公里左右，在赞布热拉田园诗般的天然港湾边，坐落着O Sacas餐馆；它最初是为了给渔民供应饭食而建的，如今却深受大家欢迎。
decisions.why: The only real flaw is the clumsy “为给”. Changing it to “为了给” fixes it and avoids the 为…而建 misparse that the proposed text and B's text both leave. 它 after the semicolon is clear, and A's “这家餐馆” repeats 餐馆 right after “餐馆；”.
The problem is real, but #18 already fixes it in a rewrite of the same summary sentence (部分是因为交通不便). Applying both would conflict.

decisions.final: 从阿连特茹延伸到阿尔加维的一段100公里长的海岸线是全欧洲最壮美的，却似乎鲜为人知，部分是因为交通不便，部分则与海滩边缺少住处有关。
decisions.why: This fixes where the coastline is (Alentejo into the Algarve, per [13]), gives the reasons a clear cause link, keeps 似乎, and matches the term 鲜为人知. B's 一段 is right because this is the coastline's first mention in the summary, so 这段 would have nothing to refer back to.

decisions.final: 事实上，开放式的创造，再加上没有方框可以给正确答案打钩，这一整套做法会让一些人觉得自己置身于一片相当令人不安的领域。
decisions.why: The current 「是这样一片领地：一旦置身其中」 reads as translationese. The proposal wrongly attaches 这一整套做法 to the creativity alone. A fixes the ending, keeps both items under 'the whole business of' and changes the least, and 置身于 matches the gloss for find oneself in.

decisions.final: 然而，如果我们把“语言”换成“叙事”，尤其是如果把叙事当作一个创造性的过程来对待，吸引学生投入其中，让他们觉得与文本之间的关系“属于”自己，那么这就会改变课堂上的互动，让此时已成为读者的学生比以前离语言——或者说叙事——近得多。
decisions.why: 「拥有……关系」 is unidiomatic, and the quoted 'own' means a sense of ownership. B's 「关系“属于”自己」 says this exactly. It is cleaner than the proposed 是“属于”自己的 frame.

decisions.final: （用于条件句，加强语气）真的；（否定时）根本
decisions.why: This is the emphatic 'at all' in a conditional, so 究竟 (the question use) is wrong. The proposed 终究 adds a new error. 根本 stays, labelled, because the ZH line renders the clause as 根本不会, and 到底 is left out as unnatural in a conditional.

decisions.final: adv. 根据（该理论）；据此
decisions.why: Here whereby means 'according to which (the theory)', so 凭此/借以 gives the wrong sense. This keeps the all-Chinese gloss style (no English parenthetical) and avoids the redundant 依据 in B's version.

decisions.final: 过于频繁地；动不动就
decisions.why: 太常 is not idiomatic. Both verifiers agree that 往往 is redundant. 过于频繁地 is exact.

decisions.final: n. 创造性；创造力（此处指创造性的活动）
decisions.why: 创造 is not a dictionary sense of creativity. The ZH line renders 'open-ended creativity' as 开放式的创造, so the contextual note keeps the gloss matched to the line while giving the correct senses.

decisions.final: 国民服役的机会将向一切有需要的人开放；而且，毫无疑问，如今这些问题已是如此根深蒂固的结构性问题，又如此棘手，以至于任何解决办法都将需要联邦政府大规模干预。
decisions.why: “如此具有结构性”是翻译腔，而且漏了 so…that 的结果关系。原提议的“如此深地根植于社会结构之中”读来生硬，还把含义窄化成了“社会”。B 的改法保留了“结构性”（与释义一致），也补上了“以至于”，读来自然。
这一条与 index 5 修改的是同一段概要，改后结果相同，由 index 5 处理即可。两条都用，会在这段重叠文字上通不过“必须恰好匹配一次”的检查。

decisions.final: 我们都知道，如今公共部门正处于困难时期，但眼前就有一个机会，可以为美国的劳动力队伍增添精力充沛、能干的人手。
decisions.why: “这里就有一个机会”是照字面翻 here's，“眼前”更地道。前面的“眼下”改成“如今”，避免与“眼前”重复。两位核查员给出的改文完全相同。

decisions.final: 为他们提供一种类似军队、有着切实国内目标的环境，可能会产生惊人的效果。
decisions.why: 两个“的”挨在一起确实拖沓，但“带有……目标”的搭配不如“有着……目标”自然。所以只删掉中间那个“的”，保留“有着”，意思不变。

decisions.final: 一到那里，就有某个认识盖茨比的人替他们作个介绍，此后他们的一举一动就按游乐园里的那一套行为规矩来。
decisions.why: 引见 implies they were presented to Gatsby, which contradicts [24] (they often never met him). B's 替他们作个介绍 means exactly 'introduced them'. The proposal's 介绍一番 can read as 'explained things', and A's 出面 adds a nuance the English lacks.

decisions.final: 一队承办宴席的人至少每两个星期来一趟，带着几百英尺长的帆布，还有许许多多的彩灯，足以把盖茨比偌大的花园装点成一棵圣诞树。
decisions.why: The current 每两个星期一次，就会有……到来 is clumsy. 每隔两个星期 is ambiguous and could mean less often than a fortnight. Putting the frequency in the verb phrase (至少每两个星期来一趟) is exact and the most natural of the options.
……中的一位 is normal, accurate Chinese narrative and not translationese. The change is only a style preference.
Without the third 他们, the nearest subject is 汽车, which blurs who 'ended up' at the door. The repeated subject is natural and clearer.

decisions.final: 满潮；高潮（指潮位最高）
decisions.why: high tide is the tide at its highest point (满潮/高潮), not a rising tide (涨潮), so the exact sense should come first. A's note keeps 高潮 from being read as 'climax'. Note for the orchestrator: [3] ZH 下午涨潮时 would ideally become 下午满潮时 to match, but that line was not one of these items.

decisions.final: v. （声音）定在某一音高；定调
decisions.why: pitch itself does not mean 升高; the rise comes from 'a key higher', so the current gloss teaches the wrong meaning. A's text keeps the correct sense and 定调 without the proposal's awkward （音调）调到. B says the same thing in more words.

decisions.final: 那个星期六一大早，一个身穿知更鸟蛋青色制服的司机穿过我家的草坪，送来他雇主的一封短笺，正式得出人意料：上面说，如果我能光临他当晚的“小小派对”，那将完全是盖茨比的荣幸。
decisions.why: party is the passage's key term and is rendered 派对 in [19], [24] and the summary. The ironic quoted 'little party' should echo that term so the contrast with the huge party is clear. This is a one-word edit.

decisions.final: 过去，黑客行为就是一些书呆子气的大学生在自己的卧室里不停地敲键盘，好让长辈们恼火。
decisions.why: Both verifiers are right that 指的是 reads like a definition and 为的是 is too heavy, and that 不过是 and 躲在 add meaning. Keeping 过去， preserves the 过去/如今 contrast with the next sentence, and 好让 avoids B's 好惹, which can be misread as in 不好惹.
The missing antecedent is real, but the accepted item 19 rewrites the same summary text and fixes it better. Applying this edit as well would conflict with that one.

decisions.final: 数据泄露事件规模越来越大，也越来越常见。
decisions.why: 正变得 + 规模越来越大 is translationese, and 的规模 would make 规模 the subject of 越来越常见. Using 数据泄露事件 as the topic fixes both problems, and the wording matches the summary.

decisions.final: 未来几年，从汽车到家用电器再到医疗设备，数十亿台新设备将装上微型计算机，借此连上网络，变得更加有用。
decisions.why: 由……把 is clumsy, and the proposed 计算机会 can be misparsed as 计算/机会. 借此 keeps the computers as the means of connecting the devices and making them more useful, and it reads most naturally.

decisions.final: adj. 组织严密的（此处为比较级 better-organised：组织更严密的）
decisions.why: The headword is now well-organised, so the gloss should give the base sense and also the sense used in this sentence. 有条理的 describes a methodical person, which is the wrong sense for groups of hackers.

decisions.final: 屡屡；（令人遗憾地）太经常
decisions.why: 往往 drops the regret in all too, and 太常（发生） is unidiomatic. B puts 屡屡 first, which matches the revised ZH, and adds the nuance in standard wording.

decisions.final: n. 通信（此义常用复数 communications）
decisions.why: 交流 is the wrong sense in communications networks. 指通信系统 would make the phrase read as 通信系统网络, so the simpler plural note is the exact fix.

decisions.final: adj. 重要的；知名的
decisions.why: In 'major universities', major means important or leading, not 'main' (主要的). The core sense 重要的 comes first and the contextual 知名的 second. Both verifiers proposed exactly this.

decisions.final: adj. 重要的；知名的
decisions.why: Same as sentence 21: drop the wrong sense 主要的 and keep the gloss consistent across both occurrences of 'major universities'.

decisions.final: 你很少会听到学院院长或大学校长谈起这些。
decisions.why: The current line is a calque (关于这一点 placed first, with 听不到多少 left hanging). The proposal's 这方面的话 is too colloquial, and 能 wrongly adds 'ability'. Verifier A's line keeps won't (会), 'not much' (很少), the speakers and the referent (这些), and reads most naturally.
